_meta.source: Lyadov, 10 Settings from the Obikhod, Op.61 (1910). Public domain.
_meta.pipeline: IMSLP scan -> Audiveris OMR -> music21 chordify -> this
_meta.caveat: OMR output. Verify against the score before trusting any individual chord; the aggregate statistics are the point.
_meta.boundaries: Exported per SHEET, not per piece (Audiveris wrote all 10 movements to one filename, so per-sheet was the way to keep them separate). A setting spanning two sheets loses the transition at the seam; a sheet holding the end of one setting and the start of the next yields one spurious transition. Both are small against ~500 chords.
_meta.unmetered: Audiveris reported no target measure duration throughout -- correct for unmetered chant. Pitches and chord SUCCESSION are the trustworthy output; exact durations are approximate. This corpus uses succession only.
